evidence.note: drifted is written as historyRewound || changedOperations.length > driftCap, so historyRewound => drifted; rewind-without-drift is unrepresentable.

fullRecompute is O.isNone(previous) || drifted, so drifted => fullRecompute. First-run (no previous) is fullRecompute without drifted; rewind-without-full and drift-without-full are never constructed.

notes: Recompute cause incremental|first|cap-drift|rewind-drift. OntologyInferenceResult already stores drifted+fullRecompute; historyRewound is flattened into drifted.

disqualifier.note: open is dialog visibility; selectedProposal is reject vs supersede payload. openRejectReview writes open true with none; openSupersessionReview writes open true with some; onReviewDialogOpenChange toggles only open, so closed-with-leftover-proposal is legal. Not flag-duplicating presence.
